'''Sidharra''' was a [[Grand Vicar]] of the [[Pius Dea]] cult. During the [[Pius Dea Era]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] was the spiritual leader of a [[cathedral ship]] that was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. The planet's monarchs were descended from Sidharra.<ref name="Strongholds" />
